senses.definition: n.f. water-course;—ת׳ Je 30:13 +; cstr. תְּעָלַת Is 7:3 + 2 times; pl. sf. תְּעָלֹתֶיהָ Ez 31:4;—
water-course, conducted for irrigation Ez 31:4; hence poet., channel for rain Jb 38:25.
conduit, 2 K 18:17 = Is 36:2; Is 7:3, cf. 2 K 20:20.
trench, 1 K 18:32, 35, 38.
